key_insight: A hybrid convolutional VAE plus deterministic smile refit can reconstruct and complete crypto implied-volatility surfaces far better than a smile-only model, especially when large sections of the surface are missing.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical, arbitrage-aware surface completion pipeline for crypto options pricing, risk, and real-time monitoring with no added inference cost over the parametric fallback.
method: Train a convolutional variational autoencoder on 6×7 BTC/ETH implied-volatility grids.
Combine the learned surface with a quadratic smile refit via a per-tenor routing rule.
Use reconstruction error to flag unusual market events and surface regime shifts.
evidence_signal: On 6,034 hourly Binance Options surfaces from May–October 2023, the model achieved 0.94–1.56 vol-point hidden-cell RMSE, and the hybrid reached 0.83 vol points at 50% masking versus 7.00 for smile refit alone.
watch_item: Performance is demonstrated on BTC and ETH over one historical window, so robustness to other assets, regimes, and live market drift still needs validation.
paper_title: Beyond the Smile: A Hybrid Convolutional VAE for Crypto Volatility Surfaces
